{{Quote|Your mother would be very proud of you.|Finn's mother to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Anakin to the Rescue">''[[Anakin to the Rescue]]''</ref>}}
'''Finn's mother''' lived with him on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], she helped [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] return to the Jedi Temple after he helped [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Finn (boy)|son]] repair their malfunctioning [[Nanny droid/Legends|nanny droid]].
